show_tier_grid.description: When true, renders iso-value diagonal tier grid lines

show_x_mean_line.description: When true, renders the mean reference line on the X axis

show_y_mean_line.description: When true, renders the mean reference line on the Y axis

point_color_mode.description: Color mode for scatter plot points; absence means default marker color

cluster_method.description: Clustering method; null means clustering is off. k_means groups points over both standardized axes; natural_breaks forms ordered tiers along one axis or the combined score

cluster_count.description: Number of clusters; null means choose automatically by silhouette score

natural_breaks_axis.description: Value natural_breaks tiers are formed along; combined is the direction-aware sum of standardized X and Y

show_cluster_regions.description: When true, renders a convex-hull region and labeled centroid per cluster

show_cluster_summary.description: When true, renders the per-cluster summary panel below the chart

cluster_names.description: Custom cluster names by position in best-first cluster order; null or empty entries use the automatic name

axis.description: Axis the reference line is drawn on

value.description: Position of the reference line along the axis (must be finite)

label.description: Display label for the reference line

color.description: Hex color string for the reference line

reference_lines.description: Custom reference lines to render on the chart axes

custom_title.description: Custom chart title; null means use auto-generated title

custom_subtitle.description: Custom chart subtitle; null means use auto-generated subtitle

custom_x_axis_title.description: Custom X axis title; null means use auto-generated title

custom_y_axis_title.description: Custom Y axis title; null means use auto-generated title

font_family.description: Font family for chart text; null means Highcharts default
